## Outstanding evidence and exclusions

The exact alpha.10 mainnet/Base/Aero library live tests and all three campaigns
passed on 18 November, followed by the repaired 301.98-second V2 soak and six
canonical end checks. All 32,264 campaign quotes matched. The soak's strict
snapshot quote matched its pinned on-chain reference with no missing state;
its optional latest-head differential remained inconclusive. Failed attempts,
the existing three-chain component/recovery evidence and cumulative costs are
retained. The selected Ethereum/Optimism consumer qualification now passes: 1,696
library and 575 worker tests, all eight offline recovery cases, and native
pair six with 2,088.501453 seconds of overlapping validated delivery. The
independently checked native result SHA-256 is
`e2718fb141d48bcd24b13d4e4b604be259a13f279d1e937c89cbd39575a7aa27`.
It used 106 cold RPC elements and zero ordinary state RPC afterward. No live
Undo occurred; deterministic regressions cover that rejection path. This is
local/source evidence. The separate full-worker Linux release gate requires
the published registry dependency and remains pending. Base library regression
is separate from deferred Base bot rollout.
Component performance and offline evidence retain their recorded host/provenance;
they are not a claim of full-worker Linux acceptance.

After approval and all required checks, inspect the registry before any upload.
If the version exists, compare its downloaded archive before taking another
action. Reconcile an ambiguous upload; never blindly retry. Verify the registry
checksum after publication. Public archives remain public after expiry.

No worker-image publication, server staging/installation, production signer or
helper use, startup, custody movement, contract unpause, activation or trading
is authorized by this library decision. The verifier performs checks, not uploads.
